setup: qPCR and whole-mount ISH 10 somite to 24hpf
observed_result: ecscr expressed in angioblasts and emerging dorsal aorta/posterior cardinal vein, tracks vascular development
interpretation_boundary: Developmental zebrafish distribution ≠ native brain luminal expression

setup: two morpholinos at varied dose, score 14/16 somites
observed_result: MO2 10ng: normal 22%, mild 61%, severe 17%; cMO normal 83%; delayed angioblast migration
interpretation_boundary: Loss-of-function developmental phenotype; MO toxicity at 14ng noted

setup: co-injection human ECSCR mRNA and ecscr MO2
observed_result: normal phenotype 62% with rescue versus 22% MO2 alone; study methods vs results differ in mRNA mass
interpretation_boundary: Supports functional rescue, NOT extracellular mouse-human peptide epitope conservation

setup: confocal KDR, V5-tagged ECSCR, actin and Arp2/3
observed_result: ECSCR enriched in actin-rich protrusions, KDR overlap at cell margin not elsewhere
interpretation_boundary: Overexpression and limited colocalization do not show native brain apical accessibility

setup: Boyden chamber; ~70% ECSCR mRNA knockdown
observed_result: HUVEC 38% and HPAEC 57% of control migration
interpretation_boundary: Transwell migration of endothelial cells, NOT transport of a molecular cargo

setup: Boyden chambers 25ng/mL VEGF
observed_result: VEGF-stimulated migration 117% vs 157% of unstimulated in ECSCR KD vs control
interpretation_boundary: Functional VEGF signaling, not peptide internalization

setup: annexin-V+/PI-negative flow cytometry
observed_result: annexin-positive fraction ~11% silenced vs ~36% lacZ
interpretation_boundary: Culture phenotype; cannot infer binder toxicity directly

setup: VEGF-stimulated tritiated thymidine incorporation
observed_result: 104% vs 281% of unstimulated in ECSCR KD vs lacZ
interpretation_boundary: Reduced endothelial proliferation upon genetic knockdown is safety signal

setup: VEGF stimulation 2/5 min after ECSCR siRNA
observed_result: KDR pY951,pY996,pY1059,pY1175 and PLCbeta3 pS537,pS1105 reduced; FLT1 phosphotyrosine not changed
interpretation_boundary: Not direct ECSCR extracellular binding; potentially critical VEGF pathway perturbation

molecular_species: VEGF receptor inhibitors SU5416 and ZM323881
setup: VEGFR inhibition then etsrp in situ
observed_result: VEGFR inhibitors impair midline positioning but also deplete total angioblasts unlike ECSCR morphants
interpretation_boundary: Pharmacologic phenocopy is non-identical and not proof of direct ligand interaction

setup: co-IP, immunoblot and anti-ECSCR antiserum
controls: isotype/control serum, FLT1 and CTR negative
observed_result: ECSCR selectively co-immunoprecipitates KDR not FLT1
interpretation_boundary: Co-IP association may be indirect; not ECSCR-shuttle interaction

setup: ECSCR cytoplasmic truncation plus KDR extracellular swap
observed_result: KDR association retained despite ΔC or swapped KDR ECD; soluble ECSCR ECD binding to KDR not detected (data not shown)
interpretation_boundary: Indicates transmembrane/intracellular contacts, not a validated extracellular peptide docking surface

setup: co-IP with EC/EM, EM/EC and ECSCR TM in EMCN backbone
observed_result: Both chimeras and TMswap support KDR co-IP; ECSCR TM sequence sufficient in one construct
interpretation_boundary: Domain sufficiency in overexpression system, no direct extracellular interaction measured

setup: transfection and 20ng/mL VEGF Boyden assay
observed_result: ECSCR and TMswap overexpression decreased VEGF migration vs EMCN
interpretation_boundary: Overexpression direction differs from simple ECSCR-loss interpretation; context/dose dependent

setup: endogenous ECSCR-KDR co-IP at 0-30min
observed_result: VEGF165-dependent association peaks around 10min, back to basal by 30min; VEGF121 much weaker
interpretation_boundary: Dynamic signaling complex, not a cargo transport timecourse

setup: VEGF165-triggered co-IP with blockers
observed_result: KDR kinase and endosome acidification inhibitors block enhanced association
interpretation_boundary: Blocker effects do not demonstrate ECSCR-specific uptake pathway

molecular_species: NRP1, ECSCR, KDR, HRS, RAB7, RAB11
setup: triple immunocytochemistry after VEGF165 10min
observed_result: Perinuclear ECSCR/KDR/NRP1 colocalization and partial HRS; adjacent to RAB7, not overlapping RAB11 in described assay
figure_or_table: Fig 4; supplemental Fig 3 discussed; PDF p6
interpretation_boundary: HRS suggests sorting, not basolateral secretion; supplementary figure not provided

setup: VEGF165 time course 5-30min
observed_result: ECSCR silencing attenuated VEGF-induced decline of KDR protein
interpretation_boundary: Measured cargo is endogenous KDR receptor, not ECSCR-binding peptide

setup: cell-surface sulfo-NHS-biotin pulldown, immunoblot
observed_result: ~30% increase in surface KDR and ~40% in total KDR with ECSCR overexpression
interpretation_boundary: Surface KDR altered by ECSCR, cannot establish transport efficiency

setup: VEGF stimulation after ECSCR silencing
controls: control and two separate ECSCR siRNAs
observed_result: Reduced KDR phosphotyrosine; reduced basal/induced pAKT; delayed/blunted pERK
interpretation_boundary: Physiological perturbation risk even if receptor merely targeted

setup: subeffective kdrl 1.4ng plus ecscr 6.4ng
observed_result: ISV delayed 66/75 (88%) double vs kdrl 1.4ng alone 2/12 (16.7%), ecscr alone 1/25 (4%)
interpretation_boundary: Developmental sensitization, not stroke BBB transport

model: human placenta, hemangioma, artery, myocardium, spleen, lung
setup: patient tissue arrays, IF and immunoblot
observed_result: placental trophoblasts, myometrium vasculature, hemangioma and some non-EC/perivascular expression; major normal tissues positive
interpretation_boundary: Significant systemic target risk; IHC is not quantitative receptor binding in human brain

setup: tissue qPCR, adipose mature vs stromal-vascular fractions
observed_result: Ecscr expressed prominently in WAT/BAT, enriched in stromal vascular fraction
interpretation_boundary: Peripheral RNA is not quantitative luminal binding or protein abundance

setup: OGTT, ITT, insulin, HOMA-IR, vascular density
observed_result: knockout improved insulin sensitivity and glucose tolerance under chow with comparable body mass
interpretation_boundary: Global knockout phenotype is not toxicity of nonblocking peptide

setup: insulin exposure in primary EC; Western blot phosphoAkt/eNOS
observed_result: Ecscr loss increased insulin-induced Akt and eNOS activation without matching ERK increase
interpretation_boundary: Signaling consequence; not ECSCR-specific receptor endocytosis

setup: insulin-stimulated capillary blood flow, tissue labeled insulin, muscle IRβ/Akt
observed_result: Ecscr-null higher muscle perfusion and tissue 125I-insulin signal, with downstream IRβ/Akt activation
interpretation_boundary: Does not distinguish extra perfusion vs intact transcytosis; NO direct ECSCR-insulin binding or BBB transport

model: mouse skeletal muscle and metabolic tests
setup: L-NAME pretreatment; eNOS−/− x Ecscr−/− crossed lines
observed_result: NOS inhibition/eNOS knockout abolished ECSCR-loss-associated insulin sensitivity benefits
interpretation_boundary: Supports indirect NO/perfusion path, NOT ECSCR acting as carrier

model: mouse aortic EC and metabolic tests
setup: endothelial-associated promoter transgenic overexpression, insulin EC signaling and OGTT/ITT
observed_result: ECSCR activation reduced EC pAkt/eNOS and impaired glucose tolerance/sensitivity
interpretation_boundary: Tie2 promoter lineage specificity requires care; gain-of-function not a peptide agonist effect

setup: HFD feeding body mass, adiposity CT, liver histology/chemistry
observed_result: KO resistant to diet-induced obesity, reduced adiposity and hepatic steatosis
interpretation_boundary: Chronic metabolic adaptation not short-term intravenous peptide safety

setup: vessel morphometry, hypoxia stain, cytokine qPCR and OGTT/ITT
observed_result: KO had increased WAT vessel area and reduced hypoxia/inflammatory transcripts; improved insulin sensitivity
interpretation_boundary: Opposite to reduced migration after knockdown in other assays; vascular-bed/condition dependence

setup: indirect calorimetry, body temperature, cold tests, BAT vessel morphology
observed_result: KO higher energy expenditure and cold response, higher BAT vascularization, less hypoxia
interpretation_boundary: Off-organ physiological effects could influence exposure and systemic safety

setup: transgenic HFD metabolic and vessel assessments
observed_result: ECSCR endothelial activation worsened glucose intolerance and HFD obesity and reduced adipose vessel formation
interpretation_boundary: Dose/payload/route of peptide may not reproduce transgene phenotype

setup: genetic rescue and HFD challenge
observed_result: Endothelial-associated re-expression reversed KO benefits for insulin sensitivity and adipose vascular response
interpretation_boundary: Genetic rescue supports function, not transcytotic capacity
